scope: Critical external-validity, mechanism, and robustness tests for the routing paper.

format_replication.success_gate: Baseline accuracy is at least 0.5 at one evaluated length; source-max minus control has positive mean margin at at least two lengths; source-min has negative mean margin at at least two lengths; invariant error is below 1e-6.
format_replication.interpretation_if_failed: Restrict the causal claim to the original colon-newline retrieval format.

pretrained_utility_gap.calibration_split: Independent RNG stream with seed 100000; evaluation uses seed 0.
pretrained_utility_gap.success_gate: The local first-order term has positive directional association with the exact swap effect in competent cells, while residuals explicitly quantify nonlinear failure. No mechanism-specific Gemma outcome is assumed in advance.
pretrained_utility_gap.interpretation_if_failed: Present the utility-gap law as a local decomposition only and remove predictive language.

selection_robustness.calibration_split: Each seed has disjoint calibration and evaluation RNG streams.
selection_robustness.success_gate: Selected configurations retain the predicted margin direction across most seed-by-K cells and outperform random-layer controls on average; invariant error is below 1e-6.
selection_robustness.interpretation_if_failed: Describe selection as circuit-specific and report the unstable axes rather than claiming general head robustness.
